d:
Bihar ke katihar jile ke pothiya thana kshetr antargat rashtriy rajmarg-31 (NH-31) par bakhri mor ke samip budhvar ahle subah karib 5 baje ek bhishan sarak hadse men tin yuvkon ki dardanak maut ho gaee, jabki ek yuvak ganbhir rup se ghayal ho gaya hai. yah hadsa ee-kisan bhavan ke samip hanuman mandir ke pas trak, shauchalay saphaee vahan (traiktar) aur tenpo ke bich huee jordar takkar ke karan huaa. takkar itni jabardast thi ki traiktar sarak par palat gaya aur tenpo ke parkhachche ur gae.
Vishnuchak ganv ke rahne vale the sabhi yuvak, ganv men pasra matam
